meta.name: paywalls
meta.description: When the user wants to create or optimize in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, upsell modals, or feature gates. Also use when the user mentions "paywall," "upgrade screen," "upgrade modal," "upsell," "feature gate," "convert free to paid," "freemium conversion," "trial expiration screen," "limit reached screen," "plan upgrade prompt," "in-app pricing," "free users won't upgrade," "trial to paid conversion," or "how do I get users to pay." Use this for any in-product moment where you're asking users to upgrade. Distinct from public pricing pages (see cro) — this focuses on in-product upgrade moments where the user has already experienced value. For pricing decisions, see pricing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化应用内付费墙,让更多用户升级付费
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果您的应用采用免费增值模式,希望提高付费转化率。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize in-app paywalls to turn free users into paying customers.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your app uses freemium and you want more users to upgrade.

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求创建或优化应用内付费墙、升级弹窗等功能界面时，Claude 会以 CRO 专家身份，先分析升级情境、产品模型与用户旅程，再给出设计、时机、频率及 A/B 测试等建议。
howto.when: 当用户想创建或优化应用内付费墙、升级弹窗、功能门等，或提到 'paywall'、'upgrade screen'、'upsell' 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个免费用户达到用量上限时的付费墙
say.note: Claude 会给出包含进度条、对比和 CTA 的完整示例。

say.text: 我的试用到期页转化率低，该怎么优化？
say.note: Claude 会按试用到期付费墙的框架提出建议。

say.text: 看看我的升级弹窗有哪些反模式？
say.note: Claude 会对照反模式清单逐项检查。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to create or optimize in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, or feature gates, Claude acts as a CRO expert, first analyzing the upgrade context, product model, and user journey, then giving recommendations on design, timing, frequency, and A/B testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to create or optimize in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, upsell modals, or feature gates, or mentions keywords like 'paywall', 'upgrade screen', 'upsell', etc.

say_en.text: Help me design a paywall for free users hitting their usage limit.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a full example with progress bar, comparison, and CTA.

say_en.text: My trial expiration screen converts poorly. How can I improve it?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest improvements per the trial expiration framework.

say_en.text: Check my upgrade modal for dark patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will review it against the anti-pattern list.
